tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Paper in light, Night in dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and tiles that sit on surface. Pair with a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Haze. Tinted panels, chips, image placeholders, avatar grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface and surface-raised (13.6:1 light, 14.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions, secondary labels (6.9:1 light on surface, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo. Eyebrow labels, secondary emphasis, links in running text (7.6:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders only. Too faint for control borders: use border-control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons, inputs and focusable controls (3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an action fill.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The spark mark, plus at most one accent per view (the leader in a ranked list, the newest point on a line). Never body text: 3.9:1.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark call-to-action band and dark report covers in light mode.

tokens.name: night-card
tokens.usage: Cards placed on night.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Headings on night.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Body text on night (7.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-midnight
tokens.usage: Brand Midnight, constant across themes. Logo ink, cover blocks, print.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Brand Paper, constant across themes. Light logo ink, print stock.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Data series 1 (Midnight). Primary series.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Data series 2 (Indigo).

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Data series 3 (Periwinkle).

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Data series 4 (Mist).

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential scale step 1, lowest (heatmaps).

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5, highest.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Three ways I work with leaders.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Human-centered AI enablement, eminence systems and B2B amplification.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Practices, training and tools that help teams adopt AI while keeping their craft and their judgment.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Captions, card descriptions and footer text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and table heads. Always set in uppercase, in accent or ink-muted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in live UI (nav, dashboard header) when the SVG logo cannot be used. Never for headlines.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hex values, repo names, tabular figures in dashboards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, KPI tile inner stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card grid gaps, mobile side gutter is 20px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (small cards), row gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding (standard).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page padding on documents and slides.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small swatches, heatmap cells, inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, KPI tiles in print.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the call-to-action band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, status pills, avatar discs.

shadow.note: Sparkify separates surfaces with hairlines, not shadows.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The default card edge. Equivalent to a 1px line border.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, chips and links.
